headline: Fort Hays State put first place beyond reach
dek: Fort Hays State beat Ouachita Baptist and now hold 28 points, more than any other side can still reach. Their only dropped points came in the draw at Rogers State. At the other end, Harding have lost all nine of their conference matches.
displaced_by: Fort Hays State beat Ouachita Baptist, so the standing dek's 'before the two sides meet next' is no longer true; their 28 points are now more than any other side can reach.
